policy_parameters_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the active Accurate Resource Usage Policy parameters

avtp_transaction_id.description: The AVTP transaction ID for which resource usage is being attested

reported_resource_units_used.description: The number of resource units the agent claims to have used

actual_resource_units_logged.description: The actual number of resource units recorded in the agent's internal logs

max_allowable_discrepancy_percentage_pol.description: The policy parameter for maximum allowed discrepancy (e.g., 1 for 1%)

PolicyDescription: This circuit proves that an agent's reported resource usage for a specific AVTP transaction is within an acceptable discrepancy threshold of their actual logged usage, without revealing the exact actual usage.
TrustedSetupMethod: Solo Developer MVP Setup - NOT FOR PRODUCTION
